title: Riot X Nic Salts Strawberry & Banana Marshmallow 10ml E-Liquid
description: Strawberry and Banana Marshmallow from Riot X is a playful, indulgent blend that brings together the comforting sweetness of ripe Strawberry, mellow Banana and soft Marshmallow. The Banana note adds a creamy richness to the bright berry top note, while the Marshmallow provides a gentle, almost nostalgic finish for a dessert-inspired vape with real character. Crafted with Riot Squad’s Hybrid Nicotine — a mix of freebase and nicotine salts — this e-liquid delivers fast-acting satisfaction with a smooth, tactile throat hit and balanced vapour. Its 50VG/50PG blend is designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping in pod kits and low-powered devices. Riot X Nic Salts are manufactured in the UK and designed for bold, double-concentrated flavour in every puff. Available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg strengths. Please note: this flavour profile may contain hints of 'ice'.
